catalog.method: POST fixed URL, form body hash=xsandokBCUpdatex, Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded, User-Agent Go-http-client/1.1; Base64 -> salt[16] || nonce[12] || ciphertext || tag -> Argon2id (t=3, m=8192 KiB, p=1, 32 B) -> AES-256-GCM (AAD=salt) -> JSON UTF-8
catalog.notes: LIVE CATALOG DOES NOT DECRYPT (2026-11-13): endpoint answers HTTP 200 with the full 942201-byte body (SHA-256 f69ecdaf...), but it verifies with neither K1 nor K2; Argon2i, ChaCha20-Poly1305, XXTEA/Princie!, scrypt, alternate layouts and an Argon2 parameter grid were all tried. Server appears to have rotated the live catalog key/format after v1.9.28.1. Script reports LIVE_DECRYPT_FAILED instead of a false decrypt. Embedded asset DOES open with K2 (authentic GCM tag, Version 1.01). No own URI scheme; only generic v2rayng:// and standard protocol links.

dependencies: Python >=3.10; standard library only (pure-Python Argon2id + AES-256-GCM included in the scripts)

files.method: same Argon2id + AES-256-GCM envelope with K2 (Libv2ray.do_) -> profile JSON
files.notes: K2 envelope verified against the app's own library: configfile.json (staged) opens with K2; encrypt/decrypt round-trip exact incl. Unicode and CRLF. No real exported .rnv yet. No .sks (excluded).
